steps.title: Disinfect workstation and tools
steps.instruction: Wipe the work surface, surgical tools and the syringe with 70 % EtOH; if working in a hood, expose the area to UV light for 15–30 min. Autoclave the NanoFil syringe or sterilize it according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Wear gloves and decontaminate them with 70 % EtOH.

steps.title: Assemble pup mask and heating pad
steps.instruction: Using scissors, cut a 200 µL pipette tip so one end fits the anesthesia tube and the other end fits the pup’s nose; attach the tip to 1/8‑in. inner‑diameter tubing. Place the assembled mask on a heating pad and secure it with tape or Blu‑Tack. (Alternative: a 1 mL tip or plastic Pasteur pipette tip can be used; 1/4‑in. tubing and fittings are also acceptable.)

steps.title: Prepare viral vector for injection
steps.instruction: Retrieve the required amount of AAV‑hM4D(Gi) aliquots from the –80 °C freezer, keep them on ice and thaw. Add 0.4–4 µL glycerol (or glycerol/PBS with 1 % green dye) to each aliquot using a fresh filtered tip; discard the used tip into an autoclavable bag or Virkon solution. Keep the virus‑containing liquid on ice.

steps.title: Load virus into NanoFil syringe
steps.instruction: Mount the NanoFil needle on the NanoFil syringe and attach the syringe to the stereotaxic frame. Place the tube with virus vertically on Blu‑Tack near the heating pad. Using the pump, withdraw the virus‑containing liquid plus an extra 100 nL (to compensate for loss) at 10 nL · s⁻¹.

steps.title: Anesthetize the neonatal pup
steps.instruction: Turn on a heating pad and set it to 34–35 °C. Adjust the isoflurane unit to deliver 4.7–4.8 % isoflurane with appropriate air pressure. Place the pup in the anesthesia box for at least 2 min until breathing slows. Transfer the pup to the mask, support the head on a flat pillow made from a small wipe, and tape the body to the heating pad. Reduce isoflurane to 2–2.5 % and monitor breathing; if breathing becomes fragmented, remove the pup immediately.

steps.title: Perform viral injection
steps.instruction: Clean the pup’s head with a cotton bud soaked in 70 % EtOH. Adjust the stereoscope light to visualize the lambda vascular landmark. Set coordinates relative to lambda (e.g., dorsal striatum: AP +2.4 mm, ML ±1.2 mm). Lower the needle slowly to the first DV coordinate (2.3 mm); if the skull resists, use a 30 G needle to make a small hole. Inject 150 nL of virus at 5 nL · s⁻¹. Wait 5 min, then withdraw the needle slowly. Repeat for the second DV coordinate (2.7 mm) with the same volume and speed. After each injection, clean the site with hydrogen peroxide‑soaked cotton bud and dry.

substeps.instruction: Locate lambda as intersection of three blood vessels.
Set AP and ML coordinates, then lower to DV.
If needed, pre‑drill skull with 30 G needle.

steps.title: Recover the pup
steps.instruction: Keep the pup on the heating pad until it responds to touch and moves, then return it to the dam’s cage.

steps.title: Prepare CNO solution
steps.instruction: In a sterile 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, dissolve CNO powder to a final concentration of 30 mg · mL⁻¹ with sterile 0.9 % NaCl (15 mg · L⁻¹). Vortex until fully dissolved, aliquot, and store at –20 °C. (Green dye solution: mix 200 µL glycerol or PBS with 2 mg Fast‑green FCF (1 % w/v) and store at 4 °C for PBS‑based or at room temperature for glycerol‑based.)

steps.title: Subcutaneous CNO injection
steps.instruction: Separate pups from the dam and place each pup on a weighing scale (use a lid to prevent escape). Calculate the injection volume as 1 µL per gram of body weight. Load a 25 µL Hamilton syringe with a new 30 G needle, draw the appropriate volume of CNO (or sterile saline for controls), and inject subcutaneously into loose neck skin. Keep the needle in place for a few seconds before withdrawing to avoid leakage. Return the pup to the dam’s cage and change the needle for each subsequent pup.

substeps.instruction: Weigh pup and compute volume (1 µL · g⁻¹).
Load Hamilton syringe with calculated CNO volume.
Hold needle briefly, withdraw, and replace needle for next pup.

steps.title: Validate DREADD expression and activity (optional)
steps.instruction: At the appropriate age, collect brain tissue, prepare coronal slices of dorsal striatum, and examine mCitrine fluorescence to confirm viral expression. Perform whole‑cell patch‑clamp recordings on striosomal SPNs and apply 10 µM CNO to assess changes in firing rate, as demonstrated in the referenced study.
